messages:
Maya: Morning async — quick check in.

Maya: What I did: audit sweep for svc-keys, pruned 2 stale IAM roles, identified a KMS alias mismatch on rdw-core.

Maya: Blockers: need infra lead approval for rotation window and brief change to the vault policy.

Maya: Today: schedule a dry-run (canary), add smoke tests to infra PR, update SOC compliance note.

Owen: Thanks — saw the IAM PR, will need role tagging + policy diff. Can you paste the diff here?

Maya: Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452

Liam: Oncall can support 10:00–11:00 PST for the dry-run. I can watch logs and rollback if needed.

Sarah: Quick QA question — how will we validate encrypt/decrypt after rotation? Suggest smoke script:

```bash
# smoke test for KMS decrypt
python tools/kv_smoke.py --key alias/rdw-ml-test --env staging
```

Maya: I'll add that script to the PR and wire into the CI smoke stage.

engsec-bot: Reminder: project rdw-core has no scheduled rotation window. Run `/kms schedule project=rdw-core window=...` to set it.

Owen: Also flagging compliance doc update — need one-line note on rotation schedule in SOC docs (doc: /docs/compliance/rotations.md).

Maya: I'll take the doc update after the dry-run. Plan: dry-run today 10:00 PST, full rotation Thursday 02:00 UTC pending approval.

Sarah: Ack — I'll prep a health-check patch for services that use that key (helm probe + extra log metric).

Liam: FYI saw a token-reuse alert in staging yesterday, filed INF-203 and linked suspicious sessions. @Maya can you confirm linkage?

Maya: Linked INF-203 in the PR discussion and added a unit test to the token issuer to reject reuse.

Owen: Can someone please review the infra PR? @Liam @Sarah

Liam: Reviewing now — minor nit on Terraform variable naming, will comment directly.

Sarah: LGTM for the smoke script; small nit on shell shebang, but not blocking.

Maya: Thanks — if no major blockers after dry-run we proceed with Thursday rotation. :thumbsup:

opsbot: deploy-bot: scheduled job created for dry-run at 10:00 PST -> job/rotation-dryrun-2190001234

Maya: I'll post results here after the dry-run and open the rotation RFC update if all good.
